import hashlib, json, pathlib, xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
root = pathlib.Path('products/research/csv-fixed-price-buyer-test')
feeds = []
for name in ('navigation.xml', 'buyer-wording-navigation.xml'):
    raw = (root / name).read_bytes()
    entries = ET.fromstring(raw).findall('./channel/item')
    feeds.append({'file': name, 'sha256': hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(), 'item_count': len(entries), 'items': [{'title': item.findtext('title'), 'url': item.findtext('link')} for item in entries]})
report = {'feeds': feeds, 'original_briefs_opened_by_this_check': 0, 'scope': 'Complete inventory of two saved navigation feeds. Titles and URLs alone do not establish a current paid request, eligibility, or demand.', 'reconsider_on': 'A readable current original buyer brief with a testable offline reconciliation criterion and a permitted response route.'}
out = root / 'director-feed-coverage.json'
out.write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False) + '\n', encoding='utf-8')
print(out.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
